narrative.overview: Independent Purple / Blue palettes with real host dark-mode enforcement through the Theme service; restores prior/requested host preference on disable. Fixes the observed light message-bubble branch missed by token-only isolation. Visual confirmation pending.
keyCharacteristics: Opaque generic panel surfaces prevent transcript bleed-through.
Solid titlebar token shared by DOM and native Windows overlay.
Official JELEE SVG replaces the old wordmark.
Distinct light stars/bubbles and dark fish/waves.
Dark mode explicitly suppresses stars and shooting stars.
Transparent transcript cutout beneath the composer: no painted backing; original scenery remains visible.
Plugins page header keeps its host controls but drops the opaque --dsw-alias-bg-base band, so the title and actions sit on the gradient.
